# radioroy — quadrf-mesh: restatement of the facts we rely on

Attribution: `vendor/radioroy-quadrf-mesh/ATTRIBUTION.md`. Source: commit
`ad3ed31` (2026-10-08). Facts are `[S]`.

- Two processes: `quadrf-lora-phy` (owns the radio through SoapySDR `mipi` and `quadrf-jtag`; chirp modulation/demodulation; framing; serves `/run/quadrf/phy.sock`) and `quadrf-meshtasticd` (Meshtastic portduino build with an out-of-tree `RadioInterface` named `QuadRFRadio`; web UI 9443; phone API 4403). (`README.md`, `docs/air-ipc-v1.md`)
- Air-IPC v1: 6-byte header — magic `0x51 0x46` ("QF"), version 1, type (1 TxEnqueue, 2 RxIndicate, 3 SetModem), big-endian uint16 payload length; payload integers little-endian. TxEnqueue: uint64 centre Hz (ignored; always 0) + 16–255 B air frame. RxIndicate: int16 SNR (0.01 dB), int16 RSSI dBm, int32 CFO Hz, int32 rate ppm (0.01 ppm), uint64 centre Hz, int16 SIR (0.01 dB; 3000 = none), int16 level (0.01 dBFS), payload. SetModem: one byte preset id 0–9 (ST, SF, SS, MF, MS, LF, LM, LS, VLS, LT); ids append-only; unknown ids ignored. (`docs/air-ipc-v1.md`)
- Default PHY configuration (`debian/quadrf-lora-phy.default`): `--ota` mode; preset shortturbo; FREQ 5800 MHz; TX gain 25, RX gain 45, amplitude 0.7; TX/RX antenna mask 1 (single element, "avoids multi-path self-cancellation"; PHY programs `interleave=0`, `autosteer=0`); low-IF receive with LO at channel − 500 kHz, host rate 8 MSPS, NEON DDC (NCO + two-stage FIR) decimating to 2 × BW; RX baseband filter 4 MHz, TX 20 MHz; `LO_FOLLOW=1` polls the synthesisers once a second and treats a GUI retune as the new channel. The DDC path moves the SF7/500 kHz 10 % PER point from −2.6 to −6.4 dB S/(N₀·BW) and costs about 0.35 of one A76 core.
- `PhyConfig` defaults: 5.8 GHz, 500 kHz, SF 11, sync word 0x2B, 16 preamble chirps, 1 MSPS; FFT size = rate × 2^SF / BW. (`include/phy/config.hpp`)
- LO-wander tracking fits a low-order Legendre polynomial by ridge regression with a prior (`src/lora/wander.cpp`); measured between two tiles at 5.8 GHz: ≈ 800 Hz rms relative wander (±1 kHz over 10–30 ms); 500 kHz presets and LONG_FAST deliver 85–100 % of beacons, LONG_MODERATE 60–100 %, LONG_SLOW and VERY_LONG_SLOW decode headers but fail payload CRC. (`README.md`)
- A "parrot" repeater mode and a mesh monitor exist (`docs/mesh-monitor.md`). Licence GPL-3.0; adapts bit-level chains from `gr-lora_sdr` and `gr-lora`.
